name: What preparation should I make before listing a luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What preparation should I make before listing a luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before listing a luxury property, prepare by ensuring the home is in pristine condition. This often includes professional staging, high-quality photography and videography, and addressing any necessary repairs or upgrades. Documentation of any significant improvements, property features, or unique aspects is also vital for marketing. Gathering these details beforehand allows for a smoother listing process and helps present the property in the best possible light to discerning buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare a luxury listing by ensuring the property is in pristine condition, professionally staged, and documented with high-quality media and improvement details.
